command:
git config user.email ci@example.com; git config user.name ci
git fetch -q --no-tags origin +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main +refs/heads/feat/libc-internal-*:refs/remotes/origin/feat/libc-internal-*
git fetch -q --no-tags --deepen=40 origin
git merge-base HEAD origin/main || echo "no merge base"
B="feat/libc-internal-exception-base-destructors feat/libc-internal-locale-base-objects feat/libc-internal-ios-base-destructor feat/libc-internal-pad-destructor"
for b in $B; do git checkout -q origin/$b; echo "=== conventions $b"; python3 tools/check_conventions.py --base origin/main 2>&1 | tail -15 || echo "CONVENTIONS FAILED $b"; done
git checkout -q -b combo origin/feat/libc-internal-exception-base-destructors
for b in feat/libc-internal-locale-base-objects feat/libc-internal-ios-base-destructor feat/libc-internal-pad-destructor; do git merge -q --no-edit origin/$b && echo "merged $b cleanly"; done
git log --oneline -6
git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 -q || git submodule update --init --recursive -q
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache > /tmp/configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 /tmp/configure.log; exit 1; }
T="guest_libc_internal_exception_destructors_tests guest_libc_internal_locale_objects_tests guest_libc_internal_ios_base_tests guest_libc_internal_pad_tests guest_libc_internal_aligned_new_tests guest_libc_internal_mtx_tests guest_init_once_tests guest_locale_tests guest_libc_threads_tests"
cmake --build build --target $T libSceLibcInternal > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 || { grep -B2 -A12 "error" /tmp/build.log | head -150; exit 1; }
echo BUILD_OK
ctest --test-dir build -R "guest_libc_internal|guest_init_once|guest_locale$|guest_libc_threads$" --output-on-failure --timeout 60
cmake --build build --target libs > /tmp/libs.log 2>&1 && echo "libs target built" || { grep -B2 -A8 "error" /tmp/libs.log | head -40; }
for P in $(find build -name "libSceLibcInternal*.prx" -o -name "libSceLibcInternal.so" | head -3); do echo "== $P"; for n in XFh0C66aEms OypvNf3Uq3c xiqd+QkuYXc pN02FS5SPgg YXVCU6PdgZk dsJKehuajH4 X9D8WWSG3As XyJPhPqpzMw; do c=$(nm -D --defined-only "$P" | awk '{print $3}' | grep -cx -- "$n"); echo "$n exported $c time(s)"; done; done
